name: Compare table
description: A dark table comparing two to four runs: one row per metric with a label, and per run its name, a bar that grows to value ÷ the row's largest and the value as text. Rows come in one after another from `start` seconds, `step` apart, bars growing over `grow` seconds. Every run is drawn the same way (no highlighted winner).
author: Biliup

names.description: The runs compared, e.g. two models.

values.description: One per name; bars are value ÷ the row's largest.

text.description: The values as shown (default the numbers).

start.description: Seconds from the item's start to the first row (default 0.35).

grow.description: Seconds a bar takes to grow (default 0.7).

size.description: The names' text size in px for a 1400 px wide box (default 24).
